attempts.summary: Established a file-integrity baseline for /etc on node1 (Alpine 3.23) since AIDE/tripwire/samhain/integrit are not packaged for this Alpine repo set. Built a manual baseline under /var/lib/file-integrity (root-only, 0700/0600): sha256 hashes of all regular files (277), a sorted file/symlink list (305 entries), and a stat-based metadata manifest covering type/mode/uid/gid/size/mtime for files, dirs, and symlinks (377 entries), plus a self-hash manifest.sha256 to detect tampering of the baseline itself. Installed /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity-check.sh (root-only) that recomputes and diffs against the baseline and reports CLEAN or CHANGES DETECTED with the specific file(s) involved. Verified detection works by injecting a test change (appended line to /etc/motd, new file /etc/integrity-test-newfile.txt) -> check correctly reported FAILED/added-file, then reverted and regenerated the baseline against the confirmed-clean current state. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id (2975533b...) and a CLEAN baseline check, issued a native `reboot` whose acknowledgement returned before disconnect, polled until exec access returned, confirmed a new boot_id (60c3dc62...) proving an actual restart, and confirmed post-restart that the baseline files, manifest self-hash, and /etc integrity check all remained intact and CLEAN.
